episodeTitle: Three mass movements, roughly ten years apart

prompt.en: Put these in order, earliest first.
prompt.hi: इन्हें क्रम में लगाइए, सबसे पहले वाला ऊपर।

takeaway.en: Local struggles first (1917–18), then three national waves about ten years apart: 1920, 1930, 1942.
takeaway.hi: पहले स्थानीय संघर्ष (1917–18), फिर लगभग दस-दस साल के अंतर पर तीन राष्ट्रीय लहरें: 1920, 1930, 1942।

sources: NCERT Class 8, Our Pasts III, ch. 9 'The Making of the National Movement: 1870s–1947'
NCERT Class 12, Themes in Indian History III, ch. 13 'Mahatma Gandhi and the Nationalist Movement'

review.note: Written by Claude from the listed sources, 14 Nov 2026. Hindi by Claude. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor.
